title: Review of c24's thin-film negative: on fresh seeds 5-6 and at dt/2, active polar thin-film drops split and re-fuse (merges >= splits) and coarsen to 1-3 bodies, with 0-1 persistent splits; replicated
summary: labkit re-runs of the sighting's world.py (128^2, t=4000) on fresh seeds. Defaults (seed 5): 15 splits, 1 persistent, 19 merges, 17 -> 3 bodies, no motion. g2 (mu0 0, chpa 0.2, ca 0.2; seed 5): 26 splits, 0 persistent, 29 merges, 14 -> 1 body, max 4.0 body lengths. g3 (mu0 0.004, chpa 0.2, ca 0; seed 6): 21 splits, 0 persistent, 24 merges, 16 -> 2 bodies, max 6.9 body lengths. A real dt/2 (world dt 0.125, defaults, seed 5): 18 splits, 1 persistent, 18 merges, 16 -> 3. The g3 sheet shows round drops coarsening into elongated ridges that pinch and re-fuse. Some drops travel, but no daughter stays separate for the lineage window.

observations.F: rerun/*/FACTS.md: persistent splits 1/0/0/1 with merge/split 1.27/1.11/1.14/1.0 and 1-3 bodies at t=4000 across defaults, g2, g3 and dt/2; rerun/g3/sheet.png shows coarsening ridges

verdicts.limitation: Same 128^2 domain and parameter points as the finding; I did not run the 256^2 thick-film foam or larger drops, which the finding names as the remaining route.
